# note created at

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:noteCreatedAt`](gmeow-noteCreatedAt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/noteCreatedAt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

The creation timestamp of a note — a lightweight four-clock shortcut. The heavy case uses a reified [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) or [prov:wasAttributedTo](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAttributedTo) with full temporal scope.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Note`](../classes/gmeow-Note.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:noteCreatedAt`](gmeow-noteCreatedAt.md) from [`gmeow:Note`](../classes/gmeow-Note.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
